description: gitops/components/<name>/component.yaml: one entry of the component catalog. The Helm source is the umbrella chart in sources/, with the default values in sources/values.yaml.

baseline.description: True if every cluster whose target is in targets must enable the component.

description.description: What the component does, in one sentence.

name.description: Component name. Must be equal to the folder name. It is also the Helm release name.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Helm release (helm template --namespace).

targets.description: Cluster targets that support the component. schemas:check fails if a cluster with another target enables it.

title: GitOps catalog component
